summary: Narrow follow-up verification of v3.1 Comparison Engine after the two frontend fixes (Radix a11y title + user-facing 404/422 toast + inline error block). Ran the 16 backend pytests in test_comparison_v3_1.py and executed an end-to-end Playwright flow covering: happy-path open + all 10 sections + a11y wiring, 404 intercept, 422 intercept, and post-error re-open regression. Every acceptance criterion in the review request was met.
critical_code_review_comments: Nit-only (not blocking): on the 404 path the backend detail 'Version not found' is used verbatim as BOTH the toast/inline title AND the description, so the description just repeats the title. Consider having the frontend fall back to a longer human sentence when detail === title (already implemented for the case where detail is missing).
Nit-only: sonner toast title+description are concatenated with no separator in the a11y tree ('Version not foundVersion not found'). Cosmetic only; visually they render on two lines.

context_for_next_testing_agent: v3.1 Comparison Engine is now fully locked. Verified: (1) SheetContent has aria-labelledby -> a VisuallyHidden Radix Title reading 'Comparing <A title> with <B title>' (dynamic on data load) and aria-describedby -> a VisuallyHidden Radix Description with the legal disclaimer language. Zero Radix a11y console warnings during the entire flow. (2) 404 path: toast fires with title 'Version not found', inline block with data-testid comparison-error / comparison-error-title / comparison-error-description renders, amber `comparison-disclaimer` is NOT rendered in error state. (4) Happy path still renders all 10 sections (METADATA, WHAT & WHY, DECISIONS, PARTICIPANTS, EVIDENCE ARTIFACTS, ACKNOWLEDGEMENTS, BETWEEN-WINDOW, VOICE EVIDENCE, MCI, INTEGRITY) and amber disclaimer; Escape closes the sheet and reopening after an error correctly clears the error state. (5) Backend contract unchanged: 16/16 pytests green in ~2s.
